note: Cross-platform export-serialization fixtures for the Phase-1 exit criterion 'the same store and scope produce byte-identical output on both platforms'. export-input-v1.json is the shared INPUT: both suites build their own domain objects from it, run their own writers, and must produce bundle-v1.json / raw-v1.csv / derived-v1.csv byte for byte. Read by apps/android/app/src/test/java/net/albayyan/badan/ExportSchemaParityTest.kt and apps/ios/Tests/ExportSchemaParityTests.swift. Neither suite may copy the records or the goldens into its own source — a copy is one more thing that can drift from the artifact it is supposed to police (same reasoning as packages/fixtures/encryption and packages/fixtures/canonicalization).

files.role: CI schema-validation instance — NOT a cross-platform parity golden. Carries a logs.hydration block (EPIC-38) so the CI JSON-Schema step exercises that section, which bundle-v1.json (no drinks) cannot. Shaped as ExportRunner/HydrationExportJSON emits it, but never asserted byte-identical by the two suites — so it is not regenerated the way the parity goldens are.

Shared INPUT for the EPIC-17 two-run delta sequence (§22.6). Lives in delta-chain/ with its two goldens so scripts/verify_export_chain.py can be pointed at that folder directly — the script reads every *.json in a folder as a candidate chain link, and bundle-v1.json (a full export with no predecessor) would read as a second chain root. This file is skipped by the script because it carries no top-level `manifest.export_id`.

Cross-platform golden — the delta chain's ROOT (previous_manifest_sha null). Its bytes are load-bearing twice over: both suites must produce them, AND delta-run2-v1.json's previous_manifest_sha is sha256 of this exact file, so a byte change here breaks the chain rather than only a comparison.

Cross-platform golden — the delta chain's second link: cursor_before meets run 1's cursor_after exactly, previous_manifest_sha equals sha256(delta-run1-v1.json), and corrections[] carries a REVERSED suppression (suppressed_by null).
